article.story: INDIANAPOLIS -- — Asim Djulovic scored 20 points as Butler beat Bellarmine 92-56 on Friday. Djulovic shot 8 for 12, including 4 for 6 from beyond the arc for the Bulldogs (5-3). Eduardo Klafke added 16 points and five assists while going 6 of 9 (4 for 5 from 3-point range). Jalen Jackson shot 5 for 7, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc to finish with 13 points. Grant Neal finished with 10 points and two steals for the Knights (4-6). Bellarmine also got eight points from Jacob Wassler. Julius Gizzi also had eight points. Butler took the lead a little over a minute into the game and did not trail again. Djulovic led the Bulldogs with 14 points in the first half to help put them up 41-22 at the break. Butler pulled away with an 8-0 run in the second half to extend a 19-point lead to 27 points. The Bulldogs outscored Bellarmine by 17 points in the final half, as Klafke led the way with a team-high 10 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
